name: DrawBonusExpMessage
comment: $CAAD = 1/2/3 Gold / Silver / Bronze Trophy ($14B6-$14B8); $14-$19 "for beating" Putts .. Luigi (text $47+); other Wario; plus "Adding EXP Pts" ($14B5)

name: CopyEvenBytes
comment: c bytes from every second byte of de to hl

name: DrawBeatingLine
comment: for beating ($14B9) + opponent name text hl

name: ShowPictureScreen
comment: bank 48 export $0A (08:4F7B when wHolesLeft = $0A): LZ full-screen picture (48:5F4C 48:6776 48:6801) for up to $0E10 frames (1 min) or a key

name: ExpFrameTileTable
comment: 20 x 5 (tile attr) pairs

name: GfxPromptStrings
comment: tile-string records (x y attr tiles 0) used by 48:4A81 / 48:4AC3

name: CharAnimStub1
comment: bank 42 export 2 (01:4118): ret

name: CharAnimStub0
comment: bank 42 export 0 (62 / 66): ret

name: InitCharSprite
comment: bank 42 export 4: character $C810 -> record from 42:41F2 (OBJ palette 6 and four pointers to $D540-$D547); anim state $D548-$D551; loads the shadow tiles (42:416B)

name: CharSpriteTask
comment: bank 42 export 6 (frame task of 41 / 48 / 66): advances the animation ($D54A frame timer / $D549 frame / $D548 anim; $FF ends it and takes the next $D54B) and draws the sprite and shadow

name: CharAnimFramePtr
comment: hl = entry of frame $D549 in animation $D548 (4 bytes each) from the pointer at $D544

name: LoadCharAnimTiles
comment: LZ tiles of the current frame -> VRAM1 $8000 ($20 blocks); $D551 = 1 (upload pending)

name: DrawCharMetasprite
comment: applies the frame offset (42:414A) and draws the frame's metasprite (00:26EA) with palette 6

name: ApplyCharFrameOffset
comment: adds the frame's dx dy to $D54E/$D54F; returns de = sprite position ($D54C/$D54D + offset)

name: DrawCharShadow
comment: shadow metasprite chosen by the jump height $D54F (table 42:4254) under the character

name: CharSpriteDataTable
comment: 4 words: per character ($C810 = 0-3) the palette / tiles / metasprite / animation pointers

name: CharShadowSpriteTable
comment: 3 metasprite pointers by height

name: PrintWindowString
comment: string at hl (0 ends) into window a from (d e) one tile at a time (05:4408)

name: PalEditColorPtr
comment: hl = $C100 + 2 x (4 x row $C3F7 + column $C3F6)

name: DrawColorRGB
comment: prints the selected colour's R G B as 3 decimal numbers ($C470); e = component marked with tile $0D

name: EditColorDialog
comment: A on a colour: window with R G B; Left/Right pick a component / Up/Down change it (AdjustColorRed/Green/Blue) and upload ($FF9D = 3); A/B close

name: DebugPaletteEditorLoop
comment: window with the 16 x 4 colour grid of $C100; d-pad moves $C3F6/$C3F7; A edits (44:4156); B leaves

name: DebugPaletteEditor
comment: bank 44 export 2 (debug menu 05:6B83 / 08:4708 with hDebugMode and Up held): hex digit tiles 44:4020 to $8600; starts at colour 0

name: CopyHoleRecord
comment: bank 44 export 0 (17:4298 / 66:4982): $C0 bytes of the record for course $C836 and hole $C837 (table 44:4311) to de (nibble grid + tile list?)

name: HoleRecordTable
comment: per course ($C836) a pointer to per-hole word lists of 44:7E74 records

name: wMenuWindow
comment: window id of the open RunMenu menu (05:4BB0)

name: wMenuFlags
comment: menu options: bit 7 set by every menu set-up; bits 4-6 pick the icons of 41:708A

name: wMenuResult
comment: value a RunMenu handler leaves (returned by the bank 41 menu exports)

name: wPalEditWindow
comment: debug palette editor: grid window id

name: wPalEditRGBWindow
comment: debug palette editor: R G B window id

name: wPalEditRow
comment: debug palette editor: palette 0-15 (BG 0-7 then OBJ)

name: wPalLive
comment: 128 bytes: BG then OBJ palettes uploaded by ApplyPendingPaletteUpdates (filled from $C200 by RestorePalettesFromMaster)

name: hPalUpdate
comment: palette upload request bits (3 = BG and OBJ; ApplyPendingPaletteUpdates)

name: wCharId
comment: character record +$10: 0-3 (selects 42:41F2)

name: wCharLevel
comment: character record +$12: level (max $63; 02:546B / 02:4FFA)

name: wCharSkillPoints
comment: character record +$20-$24: points given to the four skills (+$23 unused by 02:4FFA)

name: wCharExp
comment: character record +$26: 24-bit EXP (41:57A9)

name: wExpBonusKind
comment: bonus line on the EXP screen: 1-3 trophy / $14-$19 and others = beaten opponent; $CAAE = bonus amount

name: UnusedExport0C
comment: export $0C of bank 48: no caller; the bytes are neither sensible code nor LZ data
